as_told.title: 1995 black mailbox footage of an orange wobbling disc

plain: A home video from the mid 1990s is said to show an orange, disc-shaped object wobbling in the night sky near Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. A UFO investigator named James Fox, who has seen the tape, credits it to a man named Chuck Clark and places it near Rachel, a tiny town close to the base. Fox describes the moment the object appears: "the next thing you see is a orange disc shaped thing just wobbling." A man named Logan, who went with Michels on a trip to the area with Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on alien craft there, tells it from what he was told. His version is different: he says the footage, "supposedly authentic", was shot by two college kids who wanted to see Area 51, he believes in 1995. He places it at the black mailbox, a roadside landmark where people gather to watch the sky. To those who tell it, the tape is a rare piece of film of a craft flying near the base.
